    if not isinstance(number, str):
        return False

    number = number.replace(" ", "")

    if len(number) < 2 or any(ch < "0" or ch > "9" for ch in number):
        return False

    total = 0
    double = False

    for ch in reversed(number):
        digit = ord(ch) - ord("0")
        if double:

        total += digit
        double = not double
